title: DM-Lab at TREC 2026 RAG: Multi-Query Retrieval, Ensemble Judging, and Claim-Pack Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28233v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present DM-Lab-RAG-2026, a framework developed for the TREC 2026 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) track. The framework integrates large-scale evidence retrieval and citation-grounded answer generation over the 553-million-document ClimbMix-400B corpus. The retrieval architecture combines multi-query BM25, reciprocal rank fusion, ensemble relevance assessment, listwise reranking, and adaptive retrieval depth. The generation pipeline employs a claim-first strategy to extract evidence-linked atomic claims, construct cited responses, and verify source support. Across 22 development topics, the retrieval system achieved a mean nDCG@30 of 0.604. In the official evaluation, it attained a set precision of 0.455 and a manual nugget gain of 0.910. translated_title: DM-Lab参加TREC 2026 RAG评测：多查询检索、集成评判与声明包生成
translated_abstract: 我们提出DM-Lab-RAG-2026，这是一个为TREC 2026检索增强生成（RAG）赛道开发的框架。该框架在包含5.53亿篇文档的ClimbMix-400B语料库上集成了大规模证据检索与基于引用的答案生成。其检索架构结合了多查询BM25、倒数排名融合、集成相关性评估、列表式重排序以及自适应检索深度。生成管线采用“声明优先”策略，提取与证据关联的原子声明、构建带引用的回答，并验证来源支持情况。在22个开发主题上，检索系统取得了平均0.604的nDCG@30。在官方评测中，该系统获得了0.455的集合精确率和0.910的人工要点增益。额外的实验考察了重排序、证据选择和引用验证对系统性能的影响。评测结果展示了多样化词法检索……的潜力。
tldr: DM-Lab-RAG-2026框架通过多查询BM25检索、倒数排名融合、集成相关性评判以及声明优先的引用验证生成策略，在5.53亿文档语料库上实现了可靠的检索增强问答，并在TREC 2026 RAG官方评测中取得0.910的人工要点增益。
en_tdlr: DM-Lab-RAG-2026 combines multi-query BM25 retrieval, reciprocal rank fusion, ensemble relevance judging, and claim-first citation-verified generation over a 553-million-document corpus, achieving a manual nuglet gain of 0.910 in the TREC 2026 RAG track.
